violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked chicken (122F) observed in hot case in borders station.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Chicken reheated in oven to 192.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Sliced tomato (50F) and cut lettuce (49F) observed overstacked in 2 Dr prep top. York st market roast beef sandwich (51F) observed in open display unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Tomato and lettuce reportioned and taken to blast chiller. York st market items discarded.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Required
violations.observation: The food establishment's Permit to Operate is no longer valid due to expiration of the permit. No person shall operate a food establishment unless that person possesses a valid permit issued by the Health Department.
violations.corrective_action: To obtain a current Permit to Operate, contact the Health Department at (703) 246-2201 within 48 hours to make payment of the permit renewal fee. You may provide payment by cash, check, or credit card. Failure to pay the permit renewal fee and obtain a current Permit to Operate within 48 hours may lead to further enforcement actions by the Health Department including immediate closure. Establishment licensing was awaiting approval for access request during the inspection, violation will be corrected when permit is renewed.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Mushroom gravy (132F) and cooked pork (125F) observed in 1 Dr hot case.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Items taken to oven to reheat before lunch service.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Pudding (45F), cut melon (46F), and premade salad (48F) observed in open display unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Items discarded from unit.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Open Display unit observed with ambient thermometer at 40F but food items maintained above 41F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Food items removed from unit. PIC called for repairs.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. Observed Ecolab Pot and Pan sanitizer solution being dispensed in 3 compartment sink. Establishment had test strips for quaternary ammonium sanitizer solution.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a ECOLAB POT AND PAN test kit if this sanitizer will be continued in use.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: Variance Requirement, Acidification
violations.observation: The person in charge states that acidification with vinegar is used to render the sushi rice not a time/temperature control for safety food. Therefore, a specialized processing method of food preservation requiring a variance from the Health Department is used for sushi rice. SUSHI BOOTH OBSERVED WITH ACIDIFIED RICE IN AMBIENT, EMPLOYEE STATED ACIDIFIED RICE IS HELD IN AMBIENT FOR 10 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall obtain a variance from the Regulatory Authority as specified in 8-103.10 and under 8-103.11 before using food additives or adding components such as vinegar as a method of food preservation rather than as a method of flavor enhancement or to render a food so that it is not time/temperature control for safety food. EHS discussed HACCP and Variance requirement for procedure and provided instructions via email. Please apply for a Variance and upload the HACCP plan for approval to continue procedure.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the thermolabel did not turn black, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized. Main large dish machine observed at 147F.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. Dish machine will not be used for food contact surfaces.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: menu items containing raw salmon or raw tuna at sushi station must be marked with asterisks to consumer advisory statement on menu.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. Management to update menu.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: ROP Tuna observed thawing in 1 Dr UR cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Employee cut open packages of thawing tuna and returned to cooler unit.
